# ee-sound-lab

> Open ESP32-P4 firmware that synthesizes a naturalistic car active-exhaust
> engine sound via granular playback driven by CAN RPM. Independent,
> interoperability-focused re-implementation of a commercial unit's audio
> model. Not affiliated with any vendor; no vendor branding used.

Goal for contributors: make the synthesized sound natural (match real
recordings). Hard-clipping defect is fixed+verified (0 clipped samples).
Open issue: ~28% amplitude tremolo (4-45 Hz) on the load layer.

## Read first
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): full context, current metrics, where to look, review asks
- [README.md](README.md): overview and quick start

## Core code
- [firmware/main/engine.c](firmware/main/engine.c): the audio engine (START HERE)
- [firmware/main/bank.c](firmware/main/bank.c): sound-pack loader (SMP2+RLS2)
- [firmware/main/stand.c](firmware/main/stand.c): bench model (ignition/throttle/gear)
- [firmware/main/i2s_out.c](firmware/main/i2s_out.c): I2S output + amp gate
- [firmware/main/net_ws.c](firmware/main/net_ws.c): LAN control (/diag /drag /dump.wav /ctrl)

## Tooling
- [tools/audio_audit.py](tools/audio_audit.py): defect metrics + spectrogram PNG
- [tools/board_cap.py](tools/board_cap.py): capture a scripted drag from the board

## Docs
- [docs/SOUND_FORMATS.md](docs/SOUND_FORMATS.md): SMP2/RLS2/RLM2 pack formats
- [docs/DEV_LOG.md](docs/DEV_LOG.md): engine evolution notes
- [docs/OVERVIEW.md](docs/OVERVIEW.md): architecture overview

## Not included
- BLE pairing/crypto layer (device key-derivation) — withheld on purpose; not
  needed for the sound problem.
